Option 1: "بر همه گنج روان خواهم گزید - گوشه ای از خلق و کنجی از جهان"
Rough: "I will choose all the treasure of the soul - a corner of creation and a corner of the world." This seems about choosing all treasures, a corner of creation.

Option 2: "آن سقفگاه رابه از این نردبان مخواه - عزلت تو را به کنگره کبریا بُوَد"
Rough: "That roof place of the horse from this ladder, do not want - your solitude will be to the great congress." Hard to parse. Maybe about a lofty place, solitude, congress.

Option 3: "قطره از دریا چو رو پنهان کند گوهر شود - گوشه گیری فیض ها دارد در این وحشت سرا"
Rough: "A drop from the sea, when it hides its face becomes a jewel - corner-taking has blessings in this horror house." Something about hidden drop becoming gem, corner-taking has blessings.

Option 4: "دل بیاید که توان داد شکیبایی داد - ای که گوییم شکیبا شود و در گوشه نشین"
Rough: "The heart comes that can give patience - oh, that we say patience will be and sit in a corner." Something about patience, sitting in corner.

We need to find which one has a different concept/message. Let's try to identify themes: Option 1: treasure of soul, corner of creation. Option 2: roof, ladder, solitude, congress. Option 3: drop, jewel, corner-taking, blessings, horror house. Option 4: heart, patience, corner.

All mention "corner" (گوشه). Option 1: "corner of creation". Option 3: "corner-taking". Option 4: "sit in corner". Option 2: no corner. Option 2 mentions "roof" and "ladder" and "solitude" and "great congress". So Option 2 seems different concept: not about corners, not about treasure or patience. So likely option 2 is outlier.

But let's double-check: Option 1: "بر همه گنج روان خواهم گزید" maybe about "I will choose all the treasure of the soul" - maybe about spiritual wealth. Option 3: "قطره از دریا ... گوهر" - about hidden gem. Option 4: about patience. Option 2: about "roof" and "ladder" and "solitude" and "great congress" - seems different.

Thus answer 2.
